deployment: theborg cicd namespace (concourse.home), configured by home-infra apps/concourse.yaml

web.tracing.uncovered: Spans go to the cluster's Tempo; the tier has no reader for them. testhelpers/otel asserts export end to end and is kept out of CI because it needs tempo.home and loki.home.

web.tls.note: TLS terminates at the Traefik ingress.

web.hangar.note: Strict Hangar inputs are off here. Turning them on is a deployment change, not a test one: artifactDaemon.hangar.enabled/webEnabled, a store (artifactDaemon.hangar.store gcs with the durable bucket pointed at the fake-gcs emulator, or disk via hangarStorage.disk), and a hangar.key in the pinned daemon TLS Secret. home-infra sets no artifactDaemon.hangar value since 5db877d. Hangar is covered by the hangar_live contracts in the k8s-e2e pipeline, on a throwaway K3s cluster, and the output plane's tier-2 conformance runs in unit-tests against the deployed fake-gcs.

web.hangarOutput.note: The Hangar output plane (publisher, reclaimer, execution control) is not deployed here; see web.hangar.

web.hangarOutputCapture.note: Needs the output plane; see web.hangarOutput.

daemon.hangar.note: See web.hangar. The persistent-disk Hangar store (hangarStorage.disk, cmd/hangar-store) is off here too. It has unit and chart-render coverage only: its live coverage is owed as a hangar_live job in k8s-e2e, not a flag flipped on this cluster.

daemon.preemption.note: GCP spot preemption watch reads the GCP metadata server. There is no GCP here, so it cannot be covered live on this cluster at all.

daemon.durableStore.note: No durable resource-cache store is configured here; cmd/artifact-daemon/durable covers the stores against real filesystems and fakes.

daemon.mirrorReplicas.uncovered: Mirroring copies each output to a peer daemon, and this cluster has one node (daemon.nodes), so there is no peer: the default-on feature does nothing here. Cross-node mirroring is covered by cmd/artifact-daemon's behavioral_cross_node_test.go with two daemons on one host.

daemon.nodes.uncovered: Not a feature: asserted so a second node, which would make mirroring live, fails this test until it is covered.
